text: Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt Briefs Members of the Media, Mar. 25, 2026
Pass the SAVE America Act and SAVE AMERICA'S ELECTIONS.

Today, we honor those awarded our nation’s highest military distinction, the Medal of Honor.

Their extraordinary bravery and sacrifice will forever stand as a testament to the strength of the American spirit.

No ceremony is more important.

The Medal of Honor is the highest tribute to American valor — the strongest, the bravest, and the finest among us.
